Aisha: quick sync  i've found 2 broken anchors in runtime/kv-cache and one curl example that returns 404. planning to ship 3 tiny PRs today; who can take what?
Tom R: i can take the runtime/kv-cache fixes. which files?
Aisha: runtime/kv-cache/README.md and runtime/kv-cache/operations.md. anchors point to old headings that were reflowed.
Ken: i'll own the curl snippet in scripts/examples/send.sh. the endpoint moved, i'll update and add a smoke curl in CI.
Tom R: i'll normalize headings to stable ids and add frontmatter redirects where needed. will request Ken for a quick CR.
docs-bot: scan results: 2 internal anchor alerts, 1 external 404. will re-run after merges.
Aisha: please tag PRs with `docs:kv` and ping me for canary once merged. aim to merge by EOD.
Ken: noted — posting PR in ~30m.
Tom R: PR posted, requesting review from Ken.
Ken: reviewing now, small nits only.
Aisha: thanks all — will trigger docs-bot re-scan after merge and post results in #release-war-room.
